newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine September car output up from year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine September car output up from year-ago.

text.p: Argentine carmakers produced a total 28,092 vehicles in September, a 12.5 percent drop from August but a 33.0 percent increase from September last year, the industry association ADEFA said.
In its monthly report, ADEFA said September output was affected by a car model change by one of the automakers.
In the January-September period production rose 0.6 percent from the same period last year.
Domestic sales were down 6.2 percent from August and up 14.7 percent from September 1995. In the January-September period domestic sales rose 5.5 percent.
Exports slipped 18.7 percent from August but rose 67.7 percent from September 1995. In the January-September period exports increased 82.0 percent compared with the same period in 1995.
